<function name="CreateShadow" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Draws the shadow of an entity.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<code>
function ENT:Draw()
	self:DrawModel()
	self:CreateShadow()
end
	</code>
	<output>Draws the shadow of an entity</output>

</example>
